source: Summarised from Anthropic, “Tracing the thoughts of a large language model” (2025) · Claude 3.5 Haiku
title: Asked how it got the answer
subtitle: Our summary · Anthropic, 2025
text:
Anthropic asked Claude 3.5 Haiku to add 36 and 59.

It answered 95. Then it was asked how it got that.

It described carrying the 1, the method taught in school.
